title: From Code Review Comments to Reuse in Production: An Industrial Study of Extracted Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.25918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Much organization-specific code review knowledge remains embedded in comments on individual changes, and recent systems reuse it by turning those comments into rules a language model applies to later changes. Teams must then decide which rules to keep, and the evidence at hand is how often the system's later comments name each rule. Tracing the rules of one such system, Kleene, through 65 days of production use, we found that such a count does not show what a rule contributed. A rule attribution indicates neither whether the source content was preserved nor whether the comment requested a change. Of 56 clauses in 12 rules that later comments named as their reason, 2 were explicit in a source review thread, 38 added conditions to a corresponding passage, and 16 had no passage we could locate; 45 of 79 further comments naming those rules requested no change, 27 of them while stating that the rule applied. translated_title: 从代码评审评论到生产环境中的复用：对所提取规则的工业研究
translated_abstract: 许多组织特有的代码评审知识仍然埋藏在针对单个变更的评论之中，近期的一些系统通过将这些评论转化为供语言模型在后续变更中应用的规则来实现复用。团队随后必须决定保留哪些规则，而手头可用的证据是该系统后续评论提及每条规则的次数。通过对这样一个系统——Kleene——的规则在生产环境中 65 天的使用情况进行追踪，我们发现这种计数并不能反映某条规则的实际贡献。某条规则被后续评论归因引用，既不能说明其源内容被忠实保留，也不能说明该评论确实提出了修改要求。在后续评论作为理由提及的 12 条规则共 56 个条款中，只有 2 个条款在源评审讨论串中是明确存在的，38 个条款在相应段落之上增加了额外条件，16 个条款找不到可对应的来源段落；在提及这些规则的另外 79 条评论中，有 45 条并未要求进行任何修改，其中 27 条甚至在声称该规则适用的情况下也未要求修改。在 20 个构造出的代码变更上，……
tldr: 通过追踪规则提取系统 Kleene 在生产环境中 65 天的实际使用，该工业研究发现“后续评论提及规则的次数”并非规则价值的可靠证据：规则归因既不保证源评审知识被忠实保留，也不保证评论真正提出了可执行的修改要求。
en_tdlr: This industrial study tracing the Kleene rule-extraction system over 65 days of production use shows that the frequency with which later comments cite a rule is unreliable evidence of its value, since such attributions guarantee neither faithful preservation of the source review knowledge nor an actionable change request.
